House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Legacy Finance

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for United Hmong Family.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; UNITED HMONG FAMILY. +]

[+$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the United Hmong Family to provide dance and other arts and cultural programming. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to legacy; appropriating money for United Hmong Family.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; UNITED HMONG FAMILY.

$350,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the United Hmong Family to provide dance and other arts and cultural programming.
additions: $350,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the arts and cultural heritage fund to the commissioner of administration for a grant to the United Hmong Family to provide dance and other arts and cultural programming.
